listed_quote.quote: This notice is a confirmation of the proxy vote cast via the telephone for the mutual fund listed below.

announcement.quote: To approve an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization providing for the transfer of all of the assets of Fidelity Fifty to Fidelity ® Focused Stock Fund and the assumption by Fidelity Focused Stock Fund of Fidelity Fifty's liabilities, in complete liquidation of Fidelity Fifty.

deals.notes: Fidelity Fifty is a series of Fidelity Hastings Street Trust, a mutual fund; the filer in the header is Fidelity Capital Trust (CIK 275309), whose relation to the two funds is not stated in the excerpts, so CIKs and episode_role are null. Meeting adjourned from 2015-05-12 to 2015-06-09 for lack of votes (seq 7); no outcome stated.
